text: Seen again during BRL-0197 (2026-11-14): the scheduled PNG captures of a windowed automation Practice match at --window-size 914x411 are entirely black on this Mac (Apple M6, Metal, macOS 27), while the same run at 1280x720 captures correctly and the paired JSON shows normal Gameplay state with ~16.7 ms frames. Baseline main (BRL-0197 changes stashed) reproduces it, so it is not a BRL-0197 regression. BRL-0198 recorded a working 914x411 capture earlier, so it may depend on display/window placement.
